name: ds-hakkard
english_description: A custom game (self-titled 'Hakkard World', banner reads 'Revision 0.0.1, Status: Closed Alpha') built on the Dead Souls 3.8.6 mudlib -- the same 'Dead Souls 2' Cratylus-lineage engine already onboarded here as ds386/deadsouls_fluffos and dsIII, NOT dsII despite the domain-name overlap the initial duplicate screen suggested. The public GitHub repo's non-secure top-level directories (cfg, cmds, daemon, doc, estates, ftp, include, lib, news, obj, open, powers, realms, shadows, std, tmp, verbs, www, domains) are close to byte-identical to ds386's own raw archive at this same level (e.g. daemon/command.lpc's command-dispatch table and the full top-level include/ header set match ds386 exactly), and the domain roster (campus, cave, default, examples, learning, Praxis, town, Ylsrim -- ds386's 9 minus 'amigara') plus three genuinely bespoke domains (lennar, lennarmanor, northernwastes -- a custom fantasy setting with its own rooms/NPCs/virtual-room servers) confirms this is a from-ds386 game project, not a distinct Dead Souls release in its own right. Critically, the repo's own .gitignore excludes 'lib/secure', 'lib/save', and 'lib/log' outright -- the ENTIRE security/daemon/master.lpc engine layer plus both top-level runtime-save and log directories were never committed to git history at all (confirmed via `git log --all -- lib/secure` returning zero commits). Since ds386's raw archive is confirmed byte-identical wherever the two repos overlap, this port supplies the missing secure/ tree from ds386's own already driver-compat-fixed copy (get_root_uid()/get_bb_uid()/creator_file(), the log_error()-recursion guard, the runtime_config.h slot fix, the OLD_ED lib/editor.lpc+lsed.lpc rewrite, __DIR__/__FLUFFOS__ collisions, LIB_REMOTE, SetLong/SetExternalDesc/SetInternalDesc widening, daemon/books.lpc's mapping-vs-array fix, the Praxis/supply2.lpc set_pre_exit_functions comment-out) rather than rediscovering it, since a whole-file identity check on every referenced /secure/* path from ds-hakkard's own non-secure code found only 4 misses, all benign (dead comments, a doc-only reference, an unguarded read_file() of a genuinely-absent text file). ds-hakkard's own non-secure files needed the SAME dialect fixes as ds386's (an old-MudOS 'TYPE array NAME' sweep across 28 files including a real un-starred 'string oldparties' bug in lib/player.lpc present byte-identically in ds386's own raw archive, the query_ed_mode()/ed_cmd() OLD_ED gap in lib/nmsh.lpc and lib/interactive.lpc, 6 bespoke-domain virtual-room files with the redundant manual '#define __DIR__'). This port additionally discovered and fixed two missing runtime scaffolding directories (top-level /log and /save, both gitignored the same way as /secure, whose absence made the driver's own error handler crash while trying to log warnings -- silently miscategorizing ~35 harmless single-file-warning cases as hard batch-compile failures until fixed) and one 'already-consumed installer' pitfall: because secure/lib/connect.lpc was sourced from ds386's OWN post-install working copy, it had already self-swapped to the ongoing-login object, which was restored from the pristine fixed installer (secure/lib/connect.first.lpc) before live-testing the real first-boot admin wizard. Distinct game content beyond the shared ds386 engine: the closed-alpha 'lennar'/'lennarmanor'/'northernwastes' domain trio and a personal builder's workroom/scratch area (realms/muirrum) with several in-progress QCS temp-buffer files. 2432 of 2440 files pass a full lpcc_check.sh batch compile sweep (99.7%); the 8 that don't are all pre-existing non-bugs matching the exact same classes already documented for ds386/dsIII (a deliberate anti-load stargate.lpc trap, 2 builder-tool scaffolding templates, a missing opcprof() efun, a missing LIB_CAPTURE component, a byte-identical-to-ds386 harmless warning+content-level int/atoi bug in campus/chamber/elevator.lpc, an abandoned wizard scratch buffer, and one genuine content gap -- daemon/help.lpc's LoadIndices() crashes on get_dir() of a verbs/spells directory this repo never shipped, since spellcasting verbs appear to not exist in this game; left undone per this project's content-vs-driver-compat boundary). Booted clean and verified live end-to-end: the first-boot admin installer (name/screen-reader/password/display-name/gender/real-name/email), the mud's self-shutdown-and-restart-required design, admin login into a wizard workroom, ordinary new-player registration with the same age-gate/race-selection flow as ds386/dsIII (8 races), a distinct reconnect code path, and look/score/update/quit all producing correct output. Confirmed the same three real outbound network connections at boot as ds386/dsIII (IMC2, Intermud-3, and an automatic dead-souls.net RELEASE_NOTES HTTP fetch via secure/daemon/autoexec.lpc) -- do not sweep this lib into high-frequency automated re-boot loops.
